companies.name: CentralComs
companies.yc_long_description:
CentralComs is building AI Agents for property managers that tracks every maintenance call, chases every open ticket, and keep owners/tenants/vendors updated, so nothing falls through the cracks and operations never stall.

These agent work directly inside AppFolio, Buildium, Yardi and your existing stack, making real-time decisions and resolving multi-step workflows without handoffs.
companies.buyer: Property managers using AppFolio, Buildium, Yardi, and adjacent stacks
companies.workflow: Tracks maintenance calls, chases open tickets, and keeps owners, tenants, and vendors updated.
companies.analyst_positioning: Vertical agent for the messy middle of rental operations: maintenance intake, ticket follow-up, stakeholder updates, and system-of-record coordination.

companies.name: Lance
companies.yc_one_liner: AI Agents That Run Hotel Operations.
companies.yc_long_description:
Autonomous AI agents that answer calls, close sales, and run operations, so your team can focus on guests. Trusted by some of the top hotel groups in the US, supporting 50+ hotels across brands like Marriott, Hilton, and Hyatt

Built on advanced Computer Use Agent technology, Lance agents can navigate your existing hotel software, make real-time decisions, and handle complex multi-step tasks.
companies.wedge: Hotel call handling and guest operations
companies.buyer: Hotel groups and operators with high-volume guest-facing workflows
companies.workflow: Answers calls, closes sales, navigates hotel software, and handles multi-step operational tasks.
companies.analyst_positioning: Computer-use agent layer for hotel operations, positioned around phone volume, bookings, guest support, and operational task execution inside existing hotel software.

companies.name: Klarify
companies.yc_long_description:
Klarify handles every job a therapist does other than the therapy itself, from clinical notes and treatment plans to insurance claims and finding new clients.

Therapists hold the world together. They also run businesses, file insurance claims, write letters, fill forms, supervise new grads, and do hours of paperwork every night. 

Practice management software has existed for decades. It records what therapists do. It can't actually do any of it.

Klara is the AI at the heart of Klarify. She handles notes, treatment plans, clinical letters, insurance claims, between-session resources, supervision prep, and finding new clients.

Nearly 8,300 therapists use Klarify today.

Our mission is to empower therapists, not replace them. So they can focus on the one thing only a human can do. Be present with their client.
companies.workflow: Handles clinical notes, treatment plans, letters, insurance claims, supervision prep, resources, and client acquisition.
companies.analyst_positioning: Practice-operations agent for therapists, targeting the non-therapy workload that sits outside client sessions and is poorly served by passive practice-management software.

companies.name: Dodo
companies.yc_one_liner: AI agents that handle communications for clinics
companies.yc_long_description:
Dodo turns client communication into booked appointments, completed workflows, and predictive analytics, powering millions of client interactions annually for hundreds of clinics.

Our multi-agent system autonomously runs scheduling, refills, intake, and follow-ups across calls and texts — integrating directly with clinic systems to cut communication overhead ~70% and act like a trained CSR 24/7.
companies.buyer: Clinics with high call, text, scheduling, refill, intake, and follow-up volume
companies.workflow: Runs scheduling, refills, intake, follow-ups, calls, and texts across clinic systems.
companies.analyst_positioning: Multi-agent clinic communication layer that converts patient communication into completed workflow rather than another inbox for staff.

companies.name: Kastle
companies.yc_long_description:
Kastle is an AI voice agent for mortgage servicing. We help servicers collect payments, verify new borrowers, and qualify new loan inquiries over the phone. 

Rishi and Nitish met at UIUC where they graduated with degrees in systems engineering and computer science.  Rishi was the founding Product Manager for Redfin’s Mortgage Marketplace at 22 and grew the business from $3M to $6M in revenue in 9 months. Nitish patented Verkada’s motion search system and was the youngest tech lead at the company at 23.

While building Redfin's Mortgage Marketplace Rishi realized traditional lenders didn't have the infrastructure to service online inquiries and were losing customers. Nitish and Rishi are building Kastle to help traditional financial services companies better interface with their customers.
companies.buyer: Mortgage servicers and traditional financial services firms
companies.workflow: Collects payments, verifies borrowers, and qualifies new loan inquiries over the phone.
companies.analyst_positioning: Voice-agent interface for mortgage servicing where legacy lenders need better phone infrastructure for borrower communication and inquiry handling.

companies.name: Fazeshift
companies.yc_long_description:
Fazeshift is an AI agent for automating Accounts Receivable. What used to take teams of people and hours of manual work can now be fully automated with Fazeshift. 

Caitlin and Timmy met while getting their MBA at Harvard. After graduating, they started a B2B marketing software startup, which is where they first experienced the pain of this process.

The problem stems from fragmented data across software platforms like QuickBooks, Stripe, NetSuite, DocuSign, HubSpot, and Salesforce. Fazeshift’s infrastructure connects the data across these software platforms and uses LLMs to automate the previously manual workflow.
companies.buyer: Finance teams operating across QuickBooks, Stripe, NetSuite, DocuSign, HubSpot, and Salesforce
companies.workflow: Connects fragmented finance and sales systems, then automates manual AR follow-up work.
companies.analyst_positioning: AR agent for the fragmented quote-to-cash data layer, aimed at replacing manual finance-team follow-up across disconnected systems.

companies.name: Basepilot
companies.yc_long_description:
Basepilot helps insurers, TPAs and MGAs streamline claims operations with line-of-business-specific AI agents. Companies like Old Republic International, Zurich & others use Basepilot to make claims operations more efficient, less costly and more intelligent.

Basepilot is founded by Ken Hendricks and Pascal Wieler.

Interested to try it out? Get started here: https://www.basepilot.com/
companies.workflow: Line-of-business-specific agents for claims operations efficiency, cost reduction, and operational intelligence.
companies.analyst_positioning: Claims-operations agent platform for regulated insurance workflows where generic automation needs line-of-business context.

companies.name: ProcIndex
companies.yc_long_description:
ProcIndex is a full stack AI accounting firm, with a suite of agents to automate quote to cash, accounts payable and month end close processes end to end.

ProcIndex connects with your existing ERP, operates in the background while giving you full visibility into the agent actions and powers accounting teams to become 33% more efficient.
companies.workflow: Automates quote-to-cash, accounts payable, and month-end close while keeping visibility into agent actions.
companies.analyst_positioning: Full-stack AI accounting firm positioned around end-to-end back-office execution, not just document extraction or task suggestions.

companies.yc_one_liner: AI agent for construction drawings review
companies.yc_long_description: An AI agent that catches issues in construction drawings before they become costly rework and project delays
companies.buyer: Construction teams reviewing drawings before execution
companies.workflow: Catches issues in construction drawings before they become costly rework and project delays.
companies.analyst_positioning: Pre-construction quality-control agent for catching coordination errors early, before they turn into rework, schedule slippage, and owner disputes.

companies.name: Veritus
companies.yc_one_liner: AI agents for the consumer lending industry
companies.yc_long_description:
Veritus is a omni-channel platform for deploying AI agents for loan servicing and collections, including inbound and outbound voice agents. Our agents negotiate repayment plans, follow up across channels, and drive recoveries with zero human involvement.

By combining cutting edge voice AI with deep regulatory compliance and vertical specialization we're able to drastically reduce the cost-to-collect while increasing recovery rates.
companies.workflow: Deploys voice and omni-channel agents for servicing, collections, repayment negotiation, follow-up, and recovery.
companies.analyst_positioning: Regulated collections and servicing agent platform, focused on reducing cost-to-collect while improving borrower follow-up and recovery operations.
